DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatopulmonary Syndrome.

The combination of rapid breathing (dyspnea), abdominal distension (hepatomegaly), and pitting edema, alongside the elevated liver enzymes and potentially abnormal blood results we are reviewing, strongly points to this condition where oxygen is poorly absorbed from the lungs into the blood in patients with underlying liver disease. I have requested your liver imaging to confirm the structural changes.
